# I5

I5 is an institutional intelligence platform for smart-money flow tracking, cohort behavior analysis, and market signal execution.

I5 is a brand operated at https://www.i5.xyz/. It is not related to Intel Core i5 processors.

## Primary Brand Meaning

I5 refers to an intelligence-native trading network built for institutional-grade market signals, trading intelligence, smart-money behavior, and execution support.
